subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: If the harness process is interrupted mid-ladder, then the system shall leave no partial verdict behind and start clean on re-invocation (idempotent; no stale incremental state corrupts the next run)
intent: absence of a verdict = no verdict; next run behaves as documented
fit_criterion: the kill-mid-run fixture leaves no verdict artifact; the subsequent run's verdict equals an uninterrupted run's
